item.title: Fixing golangci-lint Go Version Mismatch
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: When encountering the following golangci-lint error in GitHub Actions or locally: 1run golangci-lint 2 Running [/home/runner/golangci-lint-1.64.8-linux-amd64/golangci-lint config path] in [/home/runner/work/fork-mdtohtml/fork-mdtohtml] ... 3 Running [/home/runner/golangci-lint-1.64.8-linux-amd64/golangci-lint run] in [/home/runner/work/fork-mdtohtml/fork-mdtohtml] ... 4 Error: can't load config: the Go language version (go1.24) used to build golangci-lint is lower than the targeted Go version (1.25.0) 5 Failed executing command with error: can't load config: the Go language version (go1.24) used to build golangci-lint is lower than the targeted Go version (1.
